newsitem.title: USA: Advanta CEO sees marginal Q2 profitability.
newsitem.headline: Advanta CEO sees marginal Q2 profitability.

text.p: Advanta Corp's Chief Executive Officer Alex Hart said, "Advanta is on track to achieve marginal profitability in the second quarter, and earn an estimated $1.50 per share for the full-year."
First call consensus estimates Advanta's full-year earnings per share at $1.41 for 1997.

Hart also said that "steps taken to address issues in our credit card business are showing promise, and the continued, outstanding performance in our other businesses demonstrates our corporate commitment to improving shareholder value."

The company added over 530,000 new credit card accounts during the first quarter of 1997, as compared to approximately 675,000 added in the first quarter of 1996. The company's total credit card accounts now stand at over 6.1 million.
Advanta is a consumer financial services enterprise that offers credit cards, mortgages, leases, insurance and deposit products.
